lead.label: Devlens Special
lead.headline: After the USAID cuts, where did 50,000 development workers go?
lead.summary: Up to 50,000 development jobs have gone since the 2025 aid cuts. There is no official count, and Devlens found no scheme to help the people who lost them.

alsoToday.headline: Seventy factories close as garment wage protests go on
alsoToday.summary: Border guards joined police in Ashulia on 5 November. The NBR has frozen bank accounts of more than 100 people it links to the unrest.
